items.description: AutoPost — AI-powered camera-to-post content engine. Externalized product FoundUp with own repo and domain.
items.outcome: Field creators capture once on mobile and publish verified updates across channels without manual toil.
items.pain: Repetitive formatting, captioning, and cross-posting drain time away from real-world action.
items.solution: PoC camera & intake service live on Cloud Run; Prototype completes multi-channel connector auth.
items.title: AutoPost

items.description: Kosei AI Systems — AI content automation service for businesses. Internal service FoundUp with planned production domain.
items.outcome: Small teams run multilingual AI content workflows with full human editorial control and auditability.
items.pain: Generic AI content tools strip brand voice, mishandle Japanese/English nuance, and leak context.
items.solution: Proto workspace (`/kosei`): bilingual intake + app shell; MVP connects automated production queues.
items.title: Kosei AI Systems

items.description: Peer-to-peer marketplace for selling unwanted items. List it, price it, move it.
items.name: GotJunk
items.outcome: Neighbors turn unused household items into local value in seconds instead of sending goods to landfill.
items.pain: High listing friction and flaky classifieds make giving or selling everyday items harder than trashing them.
items.solution: Proto app on Cloud Run: photo capture, AI listing assist, and local pickup coordination.
items.title: GotJunk

items.description: Enterprise-grade artifact and memory retrieval system for the p.fMALL shell.
items.entry_copy: HoloIndex connective retrieval surface is bound in conditional mode while live backend relay conditions clear.
items.outcome: Human and 0102 agents retrieve exact architectural truth in milliseconds before writing a single line of code.
items.pain: Context loss and blind vibecoding create duplicate modules, stale assumptions, and regressions.
items.solution: Incubating F3_INFRA: governed semantic + lexical codebase memory bundle; MVP opens tenant relay.
items.title: HoloIndex
